question_text: During a police investigation, a suspect is subjected to electric shocks to force a confession. Under RA 9745 (Anti-Torture Act of 2009), which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: The use of electric shocks is allowed if the suspect is a terrorist suspect.
The use of electric shocks is absolutely prohibited under any circumstances, and the officers may be held criminally liable.
The use of electric shocks is allowed if authorized by a court order.
The use of electric shocks is allowed only if the suspect is informed of his rights first.
